title: Topology/Optimizer Interaction + Attribute Utility Overlap
note: Section 24 (topology event traces) and 25 (attribute utility overlap) require running checkpoint-based microbenchmarks on A100 with the locked baseline. These are NOT available locally.

topology_events.data_needed: Per-iteration traces around 50 events at: clone, split, opacity_reset+prune. Requires C51/C53 instrumentation framework on A100 baseline runs.
topology_events.available_alternative: Phase C50/C53 results at results/a100/phase-c50/ and results/a100/phase-c53-validation/ provide gradient temporal predictability and attribute utility analyses that partially answer these questions.

attribute_utility_overlap.data_needed: Per-Gaussian gradient norms for: xyz, scale, rotation, opacity, SH at multiple checkpoints. Required metrics: Top20/32/50 overlap, Jaccard, Recall, Spearman between parameter-group pairs.
attribute_utility_overlap.available_alternative: Phase C49 lifecycle_profile.json at results/a100/phase-c49/ contains gradient concentration data. Phase C53 has computational utility rankings.

existing_c50_reference.description: Gradient temporal persistence analysis. Measures how well gradient norms from iteration t predict iteration t+1.
existing_c50_reference.key_finding_reported: C50 measured near-zero gradient temporal persistence (lag-1 cosine similarity <0.1 for most Gaussians). C53 measured workload/tile persistence (p50=0.64 for lag-1). These are distinct phenomena.
